title: Maker-Mark Stamper
description: PROGRAM: Maker-Mark Stamper (maker-mark stamper). Stamps any text with a deterministic SHA-256-based Signature mark: mark + stamp code + verification. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.
demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Maker-mark stamper: deterministic SHA-256 Signature marks."""
import hashlib

def stamp(text, maker="JAH"):
    digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
    code = "SIG-" + digest[:12].upper()
    mark = "((" + maker + ")) " + code
    return {"mark": mark, "code": code, "sha256": digest}

def verify(text, code):
    return stamp(text)["code"] == code

if __name__ == "__main__":
    work = "Self-watering planter spec draft, v1"
    s = stamp(work)
    print("work:", work)
    print("mark:", s["mark"])
    assert verify(work, s["code"])
    assert not verify(work + "!", s["code"])
    print("OK: stamp verifies on original, fails on altered text")

title: Boundless Seed Generator
description: PROGRAM: Boundless Seed Generator (seed generator). A deterministic seeded PRNG (mulberry32-style) — same seed always yields the same stream. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.
demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Boundless seed generator: deterministic PRNG stream from a seed."""
def prng(seed):
    a = seed & 0xFFFFFFFF
    def nxt():
        nonlocal a
        a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        t = a
        t = (t ^ (t >> 15)) * (t | 1) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        t ^= t + ((t ^ (t >> 7)) * (t | 61) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
        t &= 0xFFFFFFFF
        return ((t ^ (t >> 14)) & 0xFFFFFFFF) / 4294967296
    return nxt

if __name__ == "__main__":
    r1, r2 = prng(42), prng(42)
    s1 = [r1() for _ in range(5)]
    s2 = [r2() for _ in range(5)]
    print("stream:", [round(x, 6) for x in s1])
    assert s1 == s2, "same seed must give same stream"
    assert all(0 <= x < 1 for x in s1)
    r3 = prng(43)
    assert r3() != s1[0], "different seed should differ"
    print("OK: deterministic stream, seed-sensitive")

title: Pig Latin Translator
description: PROGRAM: Pig Latin Translator (pig latin). Translates English to Pig Latin and back for simple words. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.
demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pig Latin translator."""
VOWELS = set("aeiou")

def to_pig(word):
    w = word.lower()
    if w[0] in VOWELS:
        return w + "way"
    i = 0
    while i < len(w) and w[i] not in VOWELS:
        i += 1
    return w[i:] + w[:i] + "ay"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pairs = [("hello","ellohay"),("archive","archiveway"),("string","ingstray"),("JAH","ahjay")]
    for eng, pig in pairs:
        got = to_pig(eng)
        print(eng, "->", got)
        assert got == pig
    sent = " ".join(to_pig(w) for w in "the quick brown fox".split())
    print("sentence:", sent)
    assert sent == "ethay uickqay ownbray oxfay"
    print("OK: pig latin translations correct")

demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Coin flip simulator: seeded, convergence to 50%."""
import random

def flip(rng):
    return "H" if rng.random() < 0.5 else "T"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    rng = random.Random(99)
    flips = [flip(rng) for _ in range(10000)]
    heads = flips.count("H")
    print("heads:", heads, "/ 10000 =", heads/100)
    assert 4700 < heads < 5300
    streak = max(len(s) for s in "".join(flips).split("T"))
    print("longest heads streak:", streak)
    assert streak >= 5
    print("OK: fair coin behavior confirmed")

demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Tip calculator: bill + tip + tax split fairly."""
def split_bill(subtotal, tip_pct, tax_pct, people):
    total = subtotal * (1 + tip_pct/100) * (1 + tax_pct/100)
    cents = round(total * 100)
    share, rem = divmod(cents, people)
    shares = [share + (1 if i < rem else 0) for i in range(people)]
    return [s/100 for s in shares]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    shares = split_bill(85.50, 18, 8, 3)
    print("each pays:", shares)
    assert abs(sum(shares) - round(85.50*1.18*1.08, 2)) < 0.02
    assert max(shares) - min(shares) <= 0.01
    print("OK: bill split to the cent, shares differ by at most 1 cent")

title: FizzBuzz Ladder
description: PROGRAM: FizzBuzz Ladder (fizzbuzz). FizzBuzz taught as a teaching ladder: simple, compounded, most complex. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.
demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""FizzBuzz ladder: rung 1 (simple) -> rung 3 (full)."""
def rung1(n):
    return ["Fizz" if i % 3 == 0 else str(i) for i in range(1, n + 1)]

def rung2(n):
    out = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        s = ""
        if i % 3 == 0: s += "Fizz"
        if i % 5 == 0: s += "Buzz"
        out.append(s or str(i))
    return out

def rung3(n, rules=((3, "Fizz"), (5, "Buzz"), (7, "Bazz"))):
    out = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        s = "".join(word for d, word in rules if i % d == 0)
        out.append(s or str(i))
    return out

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("rung 1:", rung1(6))
    print("rung 2:", rung2(16)[-3:])
    print("rung 3:", rung3(16)[-3:])
    assert rung2(15) == ["1","2","Fizz","4","Buzz","Fizz","7","8","Fizz","Buzz","11","Fizz","13","14","FizzBuzz"]
    assert rung3(105)[-1] == "FizzBuzzBazz"
    print("OK: all three rungs correct")
